# What the chart says about Muhammad Ali

## In plain words
This page is the whole reading in ordinary words. Everything below it is the same thing said in the traditional way, with the reasons and the book references. Nothing here is new — if this page and a chapter below disagree, the chapter is right.

## About you
In temperament, the method describes someone who is direct and quick to act, with a short fuse when crossed. That is a description of tendencies, not a verdict on your character.

## Right now
Right now the method reads a strong stretch. These are the matters it calls live — which parts of life the old method considers active, not a claim that anything in particular is coming:

## Unusual for this chart
Most of this reading would fit most people. The few places where it does not — where it says something that only a small minority of charts say — are these: it is unusually positive about higher study, luck, higher study and your father and luck, higher study and your father. If you want to test whether any of this is worth anything, test it there.

## Matters that read well
- your health and energy
- money and family life
- home, property and your mother
- illness, debts and rivals
- big changes and difficult passages
- luck, higher study and your father

## Matters that read hard
- courage, and brothers and sisters
- income, gains and friends

## Matters that read mixed
- children and learning
- marriage and partnerships
- work and standing
- spending, time away from home, and inner life
